init_AllScAIPConfigs: use init_configs with AllScAIPConfigs and a flat kwargs dict to build the full model configuration
init_GlobalConfigs: use init_configs with GlobalConfigs and kwargs to create model global settings like hidden size and activation
init_MolecularGraphConfigs: use init_configs with MolecularGraphConfigs and kwargs to create molecular graph construction settings like KNN and radius
init_GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs: use init_configs with GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs and kwargs to create GNN architecture settings like attention heads and expansion sizes
resolve_type_hint: use resolve_type_hint to resolve forward reference string type hints to actual class objects for a dataclass field
